text: Many families join online, from the client portal. When they call with questions, it helps to know exactly what they see.
Remember: clients pick the plan and pay for it themselves. Your job is to guide them.
On the Membership Signup page, Maria first picks a pet. The banner mentions the seventy-five dollar credit for each extra pet.
She picks Juniper.
Scout recommends a plan for Juniper's age and species, and says why.
The plan card shows the monthly price, the annual price, and what's included.
She clicks Add to Cart.
Maria chooses Pay Monthly. Paying for the year would save ten percent.
The total shows what she pays today.
Next, the membership agreement. Point out the twelve-month commitment.
She ticks that she agrees,
types her name,
and clicks Continue to Payment.
The portal fills in the name on her card and her billing address from her account.
She only changes them if her card uses a different address.
Then she types her card number,
and clicks Pay and Enroll.
Payment successful. The page shows the plan and what she paid, with buttons to sign up another pet or go back to the portal.
In Scout, Juniper now shows as a member, and staff get an email about the new signup.
The most common question: Pet not listed? Check that the pet has a booked appointment. Remember: clients pick the plan and pay for it themselves. Your job is to guide them.
